{"metadata":{"description":"OAuth subscription LLM providers for DeepSeek Harness: ChatGPT Codex, Claude, Grok, Antigravity, Kimi, GLM, Cursor, Kiro, Copilot, Qwen, ERNIE, Spark, JetBrains, Perplexity, Replit, Cody","id":"gh:1341764343","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-subscriptions","slug":"GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-subscriptions","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"OAuth subscription LLM providers for DeepSeek Harness: ChatGPT Codex, Claude, Grok, Antigravity, Kim"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"i, GLM, Cursor, Kiro, Copilot, Qwen, ERNIE, Spark, JetBrains, Perplexity, Replit, Cody"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# 📦 @goodandready/dsh-subscriptions"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Personal AI Subscription Bridge, Multi-Account Pool Rotation & Zero-Leak OAuth for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"🇬🇧 English •
🇷🇺 Русский •
🇨🇳 中文说明"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## ⚡ Overview"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**`dsh-subscriptions`** bridges your paid personal AI subscriptions directly into **DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"** as first-class LLM providers."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Instead of burning expensive pay-as-you-go API credits for everyday agent tasks, `dsh-subscriptions`"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" allows you to authenticate your existing web subscriptions via standard OAuth PKCE. It features **m"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ulti-account rotation pools** (automatically switching accounts when a rate limit or cooldown is rea"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ched), **preemptive quota switching**, and an **in-process Cordis service (`ctx.subscriptions`)** th"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"at safely powers sibling plugins like `dsh-image-gen` and `dsh-grok-xsearch` with zero token leakage"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"t safely powers sibling plugins like `dsh-image-gen` and `dsh-grok-xsearch` with zero token leakage."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## ✨ Key Features & Capabilities"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### 1. 🌐 16 Supported Built-in Subscription Vendors"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Vendor Key | Subscription Tier | Protocol & Features |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| `codex` | ChatGPT Plus / Pro | Codex streaming responses, tool calling & image drawing (`/backend-"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"api/codex/...`) |
| `claude` | Claude Pro / Max | Native Claude Messages protocol, usage tracking (`"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"/v1/messages`, `/api/oauth/...`) |
| `grok` | xAI / X Premium | Real-time reasoning responses, billi"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ng checks & social search |
| `antigravity` | Google Cloud Code Assist | Antigravity engine (`/v1/lo"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"adCodeAssist`, `/v1/streamGenerateContent`) |
| `kimi` | Moonshot Kimi | OAuth Device Flow login (`a"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"uth.kimi.com`), OpenAI-compatible chat |
| `glm` | Z.ai GLM Coding Plan | GLM coding endpoint (`api."},{"id":"p12s7","text":"z.ai`), live quota monitor (`/api/monitor/usage/quota/limit`) |
| `cursor` | Cursor | Cursor backend"},{"id":"p12s8","text":" (`api2.cursor.sh`), billing-period usage dashboard parsing |
| `kiro` | AWS Kiro | Kiro desktop OAu"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"th (`app.kiro.dev`), streaming code assistance |
| `copilot` | GitHub Copilot | GitHub Device Flow l"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"ogin (`github.com/login/device`), Copilot chat completions |
| `qwen` | Alibaba Qwen (DashScope) | O"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"penAI-compatible endpoint (`dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`), API key auth |
| `ernie` | "},{"id":"p12s12","text":"Baidu ERNIE (Qianfan) | OAuth2 token refresh via API Key + Secret Key, Wenxinworkshop chat |
| `spar"},{"id":"p12s13","text":"k` | iFlytek Spark | OpenAI-compatible Spark HTTP API (`spark-api-open.xf-yun.com/v1`) |
| `jetbrain"},{"id":"p12s14","text":"s` | JetBrains AI Assistant | JetBrains AI relay (`api.jetbrains.ai`) |
| `perplexity` | Perplexity "},{"id":"p12s15","text":"Pro | Sonar model catalog (`api.perplexity.ai`) |
| `replit` | Replit Core | Replit AI API (`replit."},{"id":"p12s16","text":"com/api/v1/ai`), connect-token auth |
| `cody` | Sourcegraph Cody Pro | Sourcegraph API (`sourcegrap"},{"id":"p12s17","text":"h.com/.api`), access-token auth |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"*Custom vendors can also be dynamically registered via the `createVendorFromProfile` factory.*"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### 2. 🔄 Multi-Account Rotation & Rate-Limit Mitigation (`rotate.js`, `ratelimit.js`)
* **Multi-Acco"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"unt Pooling**: Attach multiple accounts per vendor (e.g. `CODEX_OAUTH_1`, `CODEX_OAUTH_2`, `CODEX_OA"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"UTH_3`).
* **Automatic 429 Failover**: When an account encounters a rate limit (`HTTP 429`, `RATE_LI"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"MIT`, `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`), traffic instantly fails over to the next healthy account in the pool.
* **P"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"reemptive Quota Switching (`switchAtRemaining`)**: Automatically rotates to the next account before "},{"id":"p14s6","text":"hitting zero if the rate-limit window reset is imminent.
* **Dynamic Cooldown Calculation**: Parses "},{"id":"p14s7","text":"upstream headers (`Retry-After`, `x-ratelimit-reset`, ISO dates, epoch timestamps) and auto-restores"},{"id":"p14s8","text":" cooled-down accounts when their window resets.
* **Synchronous Decision Tracing & Routing Explanati"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"on (#517)**: Real-time decision traces capture every account selection, rotation step, failure reaso"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"n, and cascade fallback without post-hoc reconstruction, exposed in WebUI telemetry and diagnostics."},{"id":"p14s11","text":"
* **Dynamic Model Catalog & Live Quota Visualizer (#507)**: Dynamic model catalog with pool-level h"},{"id":"p14s12","text":"ealth calculation (individual quarantine degrades rather than disables the pool), context window bad"},{"id":"p14s13","text":"ges, capability tags (`vision`, `tools`, `reasoning`, `coding`, `fast`), and live reset countdowns.
"},{"id":"p14s14","text":"* **Cache-Aware Session Pinning (#520)**: Retains session affinity for prompt-caching providers (Cla"},{"id":"p14s15","text":"ude, Codex, Antigravity, Grok) to maximize token cache reuse while strictly releasing pins when an a"},{"id":"p14s16","text":"ccount enters cooldown, quarantine, or quota exhaustion.
* **Guided Diagnostic Wizard (#519)**: Inte"},{"id":"p14s17","text":"ractive step-by-step checklist verifying credentials, network/proxy connectivity, token freshness, a"},{"id":"p14s18","text":"nd model catalog reachability without paid inference and with full secret redaction.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### 3. 🔒 Zero-Leak Credential Security & Headless OAuth
* **Zero Token Leakage**: OAuth tokens are *"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"*never** returned over HTTP API endpoints or rendered in the Web UI. The UI only receives masked acc"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ount labels, connection health, and quota bars.
* **Secure Host Storage**: Tokens reside in encrypte"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"d `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` managed by the host credentials service.
* **Headless / Remote Login"},{"id":"p15s5","text":" Fallback**: If running DSH on a headless server over SSH where browser popups cannot redirect to `l"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"ocalhost`, simply paste the redirected callback URL or authorization code directly into the account "},{"id":"p15s7","text":"card.
* **Proactive Background Token Refresh**: Access tokens are refreshed automatically before exp"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"**Proactive Background Token Refresh**: Access tokens are refreshed automatically before expiration."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### 7. 🕶️ Privacy Masking & Diagnostics Report (`v0.4.9`)
* **Privacy Masking (`privacyMask`)**: One"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" toggle in the settings card masks personal data across the whole UI: emails render as `j***n@exampl"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"e.com` everywhere (account lists, status labels, check results). Designed for screen sharing and str"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"eaming. Server-side masking means labels never leak through API responses either; the underlying acc"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ount data is never overwritten.
* **Anonymized Diagnostics Report**: The settings card has a **Gener"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"ate diagnostics report** block: one click fetches an anonymized report (plugin/runtime versions, OS,"},{"id":"p16s7","text":" per-vendor health counters, aggregate HTTP status counts, last ≥400 errors with timings, non-secret"},{"id":"p16s8","text":" settings) and copies it to the clipboard. Tokens, emails, credential refs and proxy URLs are strict"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"ly excluded (verified by tests).
* **Issue-Ready**: The same block links to the project issue tracke"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"r, so a bug report is: generate → paste → submit."}],"truncated":true}
